# Visual Design System

1. Read the approved brand direction, information architecture and screen specifications.
2. Define semantic tokens, not scattered raw values: canvas, surface, text, border, accent, status, focus, spacing, type, radius, elevation, motion and z-index.
3. Establish density tiers for management pages, operational monitoring and Clip Studio editing.
4. Define typography hierarchy and tabular numerals for timecodes/durations/metrics.
5. Define component anatomy, variants, sizes, all states and responsive behavior.
6. Check contrast and status semantics; never rely on color alone.
7. Ensure dark/light token parity only if both themes are in scope.
8. Choose or retain a UI primitive library only after inspecting current dependencies, accessibility, maintenance and license.
9. Provide token naming, examples and anti-patterns.
10. Require design owner approval before frontend implementation.
